name: XENEON EDGE Ultimate
blocker: Physical XENEON EDGE 1.0.1 retest must confirm responsive touch/click navigation, live UI updates, telemetry population, settings propagation, Smart Mode and size/orientation changes after the provider-independent bootstrap fix.
release_gate: Smart Mode immediate reevaluation regression coverage
Previous, Play-Pause and Next media transport regression coverage
runtime bootstrap remains interactive when optional iCUE providers initialize late or fail
stalled Sensors provider exact-package regression reaches READY before provider timeout
official CORSAIR CLI validation and .icuewidget packaging
Corsair Labs exact-package host/settings and real mode-click smoke
Rat Ship Maker Console kit preflight
REQUIRED: physical XENEON EDGE 1.0.1 hardware retest
final_boundary: Pass the physical XENEON EDGE 1.0.1 retest, move workflow_state back to READY_TO_SHIP, then perform authenticated Maker Console submission through rat ship xeneon-edge-ultimate.
notes: The previous 1.0.0 physical test rendered a static shell but did not load data or respond to touch/click, screen changes or settings. 1.0.1 removes all native provider I/O from the blocking shell bootstrap and adds a permanent stalled-provider regression. Automated gates are green, but physical hardware confirmation is mandatory before release. Marketplace auto-publish remains disabled.
